## Check your understanding

1. For stream `[4, 7, 2, 9]` and input length 3, what is the first input-target pair?

<details>
<summary>Show answer</summary>

Input `[4, 7, 2]`, target `[7, 2, 9]`. Each target is the immediately following token at the corresponding prediction position.

</details>

2. Why does teacher forcing not expose future tokens?

<details>
<summary>Show answer</summary>

The model receives the observed prefix, but the causal mask restricts each position to previous tokens and the current token. Without that constraint, the target could leak into the computation.

</details>

3. How do attention masks and loss masks differ?

<details>
<summary>Show answer</summary>

The former determines which positions may be attended to; the latter determines which targets contribute to the objective. They are not interchangeable.

</details>

4. If logits have shape \([B,L,V]\), what do the three axes represent?

<details>
<summary>Show answer</summary>

Batch, sequence position, and candidate vocabulary token. Each position in each sequence has scores over all \(V\) vocabulary tokens.

</details>
